title: Sphere Calculator
description: From radius, volume or surface area, get all three sphere properties with the formulas shown.
howto: Press Calculate to get radius, volume and surface area.

faqs.q: How is radius found from volume?

faqs.a: Volume is the space inside ((4/3)πr³); surface area is the skin of the sphere (4πr²).

faqs.q: What units are the answers in?
faqs.a: Whatever length unit you use: volume comes out in cubic units, area in square units.
